scope: manifest/checksums.csv · text files and 24 raw captures

before: hashes of the Windows working copy
before_zh: 依 Windows 工作資料夾計算之雜湊值
after: hashes of the bytes the site serves
after_zh: 依網站實際提供之位元組計算之雜湊值
change: Values unchanged. The checksum manifest had been built from the working folder, where git on Windows writes text files with CRLF line endings, while GitHub serves them with LF; the hash of any downloaded CSV, page or Markdown file therefore differed from the recorded one (PDF, image and spreadsheet files were not affected). The manifest now hashes the bytes the site serves, scripts/78_verify_checksums.py checks every row against what git stored, and 24 downloaded web pages and CSV files whose servers send CRLF are now stored byte for byte as saved (.gitattributes) instead of with the line endings converted.
change_zh: 數值不變。雜湊清單原是依工作資料夾計算；在 Windows 上，git 於工作資料夾以 CRLF 寫入文字檔，而 GitHub 提供之檔案為 LF，故任何下載之 CSV、網頁或 Markdown 檔之雜湊值皆與記錄不符（PDF、圖片與試算表檔不受影響）。現清單改依網站實際提供之位元組計算，並以 scripts/78_verify_checksums.py 將每一列與 git 所存內容核對；另有 24 個下載之網頁與 CSV 檔（其伺服器以 CRLF 傳送）現已逐位元組依所存內容保存（.gitattributes），不再轉換換行字元。

scope: New variable health_expenditure_pct_gdp: current health expenditure as % of GDP, all 40 countries, 2001-2022
scope_zh: 新增變項 health_expenditure_pct_gdp：經常性醫療保健支出占 GDP 比率，全部 40 國，2001–2022
after: 880 values (40 countries x 22 years), range 2.64% to 18.52% of GDP; ten columns health_expenditure_pct_gdp[_source, _url, _ref_date, _note, _grade, _verification, _source_type, _flag, _collected_on] appended to the panel.
after_zh: 880 筆數值（40 國 × 22 年），介於 GDP 之 2.64% 至 18.52%；panel 末尾新增 health_expenditure_pct_gdp[_source、_url、_ref_date、_note、_grade、_verification、_source_type、_flag、_collected_on] 共十欄。
change: Added at the authors' request, for the same countries and years as the population and migrant series. 39 countries from the World Bank (WDI SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS, the WHO Global Health Expenditure Database): all 858 values identical to full precision to WHO's own GHO API. Taiwan from the Ministry of Health and Welfare (National Health Expenditure 2024, Table 1), read from the official workbook, identical to the published report; long-term care is included from 2007 and the earlier years are flagged. Raw responses, the workbook, the report and the publishers' pages are archived with PDF/PNG mirrors. No other value in the panel changed.
change_zh: 應作者要求新增，國家與年度與人口及移民序列一致。39 國取自世界銀行（WDI SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS，即世界衛生組織全球醫療支出資料庫）：858 筆數值與世界衛生組織 GHO API 完全相同。臺灣取自衛生福利部《113年國民醫療保健支出》表1，讀自官方試算表，與出版之報告相同；自 2007 年起始含長期照顧，較早年度已標示旗標。API 原始回應、試算表、報告與發布機構頁面均已存檔，並附 PDF／PNG 鏡像。panel 中其他數值皆未變動。

scope: Link annotations in 39 PDF mirrors of archived web pages
scope_zh: 39 個已存檔網頁之 PDF 鏡像中的連結註記
before: links pointing at the build machine's local folder
before_zh: 指向建置電腦本機資料夾之連結
after: removed; every page renders exactly as before
after_zh: 已移除；每一頁之呈現與先前完全相同
change: Values unchanged. The PDF mirrors of archived web pages were rendered from the copy on disk, and the browser resolved each page's relative links against that folder, so their link annotations held absolute local file paths: dead for any reader, and naming the workspace folder, which the text files had already been cleared of (scripts/62_scrub_local_paths.py). The links were deleted and the files rewritten without them; each page was compared with the previous version as an image and is identical. Rendering now removes such links itself.
change_zh: 數值不變。已存檔網頁之 PDF 鏡像係由磁碟上之副本轉製，瀏覽器將頁面中的相對連結解析至該資料夾，故其連結註記載有本機之絕對檔案路徑：對任何讀者皆無法開啟，且含有工作資料夾之名稱；文字檔中之此類路徑先前已移除（scripts/62_scrub_local_paths.py）。現已刪除這些連結並重寫檔案；每一頁均已以影像與前一版比對，完全相同。轉製程序今後會自行移除此類連結。

scope: Health expenditure, 39 countries: the WHO date in the verification note
scope_zh: 醫療保健支出，39 國：查證說明中之世界衛生組織日期
change: Values unchanged. The note quoted the latest date anywhere in WHO's response, which belongs to other countries' records; each of the 858 records used is dated 2025-12-05, and the note now quotes the record's own date. Found by the independent health-expenditure audit of 2026-10-17.
change_zh: 數值不變。原說明引用世界衛生組織回應中任一記錄之最新日期，該日期屬其他國家之記錄；所用 858 筆記錄之日期均為 2025-12-05，說明現改引各記錄自身之日期。由 2026-10-17 之醫療保健支出獨立稽核發現。

scope: Health-expenditure audit of 2026-10-17: verification ledger, evidence labels and retrieval dates
scope_zh: 2026-10-17 醫療保健支出稽核：驗證表、佐證標籤與取得日期
before: ledger 3,365 rows without health expenditure; labels and dates from first-release rules
before_zh: 驗證表 3,365 列，不含醫療保健支出；標籤與日期沿用首次發布之規則
after: ledger covers the 880 health values (4,245 audited rows); labels from its check method; dates from each value's collection
after_zh: 驗證表涵蓋 880 筆醫療保健支出（4,245 列經稽核）；標籤依其查核方式；日期依各數值之蒐集日
change: Values unchanged. data/current_panel_verification.csv now holds all 880 health-expenditure observations, unrounded, in % of GDP, with the health audit's own result tables committed as inputs (data/audit_inputs/) and a column health_audit_2026_10_17 kept apart from the 2026-10-07 audit. Every verification label on the evidence pages and PDF extracts is now read from the ledger's check method (raw API response, official data file, archived document), which also corrects values decoded from APIs or official files that the extracts had called "confirmed in document"; the "first retrieved" date of each series is that of its values (2026-10-17 for health expenditure). Issues #31 (H01) and #32 (H02).
change_zh: 數值不變。data/current_panel_verification.csv 現納入全部 880 筆醫療保健支出觀測值（未經四捨五入、以占 GDP 百分比列示），醫療保健支出稽核自身之結果表已納入建置輸入（data/audit_inputs/），並以 health_audit_2026_10_17 欄與 2026-10-07 稽核分開。佐證頁與 PDF 摘錄之每一查證標籤現依驗證表之查核方式（API 原始回應、官方資料檔、存檔文件）標示，亦更正原於摘錄中被標為「經文件確認」、實為自 API 或官方資料檔解讀之數值；各序列之「首次取得」日期改依其數值（醫療保健支出為 2026-10-17）。議題 #31（H01）與 #32（H02）。

scope_zh: 澳洲 · 非公民（普查） · 2021
change: The authors' decision on issue #9: the 2021 Census count of persons who are not Australian citizens, read from the official ABS workbook (Cultural diversity data summary 2021, Table 2, national total), in a separate column so that foreign_nationals stays an annual series. Archived with the ABS release and census-date pages and their mirrors. No other value changed.
change_zh: 作者對議題 #9 之決定：2021 年普查中非澳洲公民之人數，讀自澳洲統計局官方試算表（Cultural diversity data summary 2021，表 2，全國總計），另列一欄，使 foreign_nationals 維持為逐年序列。已存檔澳洲統計局之發布頁與普查日期頁及其鏡像。其他數值皆未變動。

scope: South Africa 2011 census count: assessed, not added (issue #10)
scope_zh: 南非 2011 年普查數：已評估，未加入（議題 #10）
before_zh: 候選資料，母體範圍待釐清
after: not added: ten years before the ISSP 2021 interviews
after_zh: 不加入：早於 ISSP 2021 訪問十年
change: The authors' decision: 1,692,242 persons answered "No" to South African citizenship in the 2011 Census, but South Africa's ISSP 2021 interviews were in 2021 (Variable Report, DATEYR by country). The count stays documented in the known issues; no value changed.
change_zh: 作者之決定：2011 年普查中有 1,692,242 人對南非公民身分回答「否」，但南非之 ISSP 2021 訪問在 2021 年（變項報告 DATEYR 分國表）。此數仍記載於已知問題；數值未變動。

scope: Analysis notes: construct and timing rule fixed from the ISSP 2021 item (issue #24)
scope_zh: 研究使用說明：依 ISSP 2021 題目確定構念與時間規則（議題 #24）
after: decided: foreign_nationals_pct_pop; latest stock on or before the first interview
after_zh: 已決定：foreign_nationals_pct_pop；首次訪問當日或之前之最近一筆存量
change: The authors' decision: item Q6a names people who "do not hold citizenship of [country]", so the main regressor is foreign_nationals_pct_pop, with foreign_born_pct_pop as a robustness check and the irregular series not used for this item; the primary timing rule is the latest stock dated on or before the first interview, with same-year and nearest-stock rows as sensitivity. The ISSP documentation quoted is archived in evidence/survey/. No value changed.
change_zh: 作者之決定：題目 Q6a 所指為「不具有［該國］公民身分」之人，故主要自變項為 foreign_nationals_pct_pop，以 foreign_born_pct_pop 作穩健性檢驗，無證移民序列不用於此題；主要時間規則為首次訪問當日或之前之最近一筆存量，同年列與最近存量列作為敏感度分析。所引用之 ISSP 文件存檔於 evidence/survey/。數值未變動。

scope: New variable unemployment_rate: unemployment rate, % of the labour force aged 15+, all 40 countries, 2001-2022
scope_zh: 新增變項 unemployment_rate：失業率（占 15 歲以上勞動力之百分比），全部 40 國，2001–2022
after: 880 values (40 countries x 22 years), range 0.249% to 34.007%; ten columns unemployment_rate[_source, _url, _ref_date, _note, _grade, _verification, _source_type, _flag, _collected_on] appended to the panel; 61 ILO imputations flagged.
after_zh: 880 筆數值（40 國 × 22 年），介於 0.249% 至 34.007%；panel 末尾新增 unemployment_rate[_source、_url、_ref_date、_note、_grade、_verification、_source_type、_flag、_collected_on] 共十欄；61 筆國際勞工組織插補值已標示旗標。
change: Added at the authors' request, for the same countries and years as the population and migrant series. 39 countries from the ILO modelled estimates (November 2025 edition, ILO SDMX API): all 858 values agree at three decimals with the World Bank's copy (WDI SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS); the 61 the ILO imputes are flagged. Taiwan from DGBAS (Yearbook of Manpower Survey Statistics 2025, Table 2), read from the official workbook, identical to the printed yearbook. Raw responses, the ILO's metadata, the workbook, the yearbook and the publishers' pages are archived with PDF/PNG mirrors. No other value in the panel changed.
change_zh: 應作者要求新增，國家與年度與人口及移民序列一致。39 國取自國際勞工組織模型推估值（2025 年 11 月版，國際勞工組織 SDMX API）：858 筆數值與世界銀行轉載值（WDI SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS）於小數三位一致；其中 61 筆國際勞工組織插補值已標示旗標。臺灣取自主計總處《114年人力資源調查統計年報》表2，讀自官方試算表，與印行之年報相同。API 原始回應、國際勞工組織後設資料、試算表、年報與發布機構頁面均已存檔，並附 PDF／PNG 鏡像。panel 中其他數值皆未變動。

scope: Workbook README, row Health expenditure (2026-10-17): where its columns are
scope_zh: 活頁簿 README，「Health expenditure (2026-10-17)」列：其欄位所在位置
change: Values unchanged. The health-expenditure columns stopped being the last ten of the panel when the census column family was appended on 2026-10-18; the row now names them.
change_zh: 數值不變。2026-10-18 於 panel 末尾新增普查欄位群後，醫療保健支出欄位已非最後十欄；該列現直接指名其欄位。

scope: PDF extracts (evidence/extracts/): list of archived files, notes, flags and grade legend
scope_zh: PDF 摘錄（evidence/extracts/）：存檔檔案清單、說明、旗標與等級圖例
before: API-read series listed no archived file; only the first note shown; no flag column; legend called a modelled estimate grade C
before_zh: 讀自 API 之序列未列任何存檔檔案；僅顯示第一則說明；無旗標欄；圖例稱模型推估值為 C 級
after: every archived file the evidence page lists; every distinct note with its years; flag column; the codebook's grade definitions
after_zh: 列出佐證頁所列之每一存檔檔案；每則不同說明並註明年度；旗標欄；採編碼簿之等級定義
change: Values unchanged. The extracts listed only files kept in the country folder, so every series read from an API (population, Eurostat and OECD stocks, health expenditure, the unemployment rate) showed no archived file although its raw response is archived in evidence/api/; they now list the same files as the evidence page. They showed only the first year's note, which misdescribes a series whose notes differ (real and imputed ILO values); every distinct note is now shown with its years, and flags have a column. The grade legend still carried the first-release wording ("C = the value is a modelled estimate"), which contradicts the grades defined after the audit of 2026-10-07 (a published estimate is A or B by where it was read from); it now uses the codebook's definitions.
change_zh: 數值不變。摘錄原僅列出存放於國家資料夾之檔案，故所有讀自 API 之序列（人口、Eurostat 與 OECD 存量、醫療保健支出、失業率）雖其原始回應已存於 evidence/api/，摘錄卻顯示無存檔檔案；現列出與佐證頁相同之檔案。摘錄原僅顯示第一個年度之說明，對說明各年不同之序列（國際勞工組織之實際值與插補值）有所誤述；現顯示每則不同說明並註明年度，旗標另設一欄。等級圖例仍沿用首次發布之文字（「C = 數值為推估值」），與 2026-10-07 稽核後之等級定義（已公布之推估值依其讀取來源評為 A 或 B）矛盾；現採編碼簿之定義。

scope: New variable vdem_libdem: V-Dem liberal democracy index (0-1), all 40 countries, 2001-2022
scope_zh: 新增變項 vdem_libdem：V-Dem 自由民主指數（0–1），全部 40 國，2001–2022
after: 880 values (40 countries x 22 years), range 0.042 to 0.896; ten columns vdem_libdem[_source, _url, _ref_date, _note, _grade, _verification, _source_type, _flag, _collected_on] appended to the panel.
after_zh: 880 筆數值（40 國 × 22 年），介於 0.042 至 0.896；panel 末尾新增 vdem_libdem[_source、_url、_ref_date、_note、_grade、_verification、_source_type、_flag、_collected_on] 共十欄。
change: Added at the authors' request, for the same countries and years as the population and migrant series. Read from the V-Dem Country-Year Dataset v16, the V-Dem Institute's own data file (R package vdemdata 16.0, released 2026-03-17; the file's hash matches the one GitHub records for it); all 880 values are identical at three decimals to Our World in Data's copy. The data file, its codebook entry, the V-Dem Codebook, Our World in Data's copy and the publishers' pages are archived with PDF/PNG mirrors. No other value in the panel changed.
change_zh: 應作者要求新增，國家與年度與人口及移民序列一致。讀自 V-Dem Country-Year Dataset v16，即 V-Dem 研究所自身之資料檔（R 套件 vdemdata 16.0，2026-03-17 發布；檔案雜湊值與 GitHub 所記錄者相同）；880 筆數值與 Our World in Data 之轉載於小數三位完全相同。資料檔、其編碼簿條目、《V-Dem Codebook》、Our World in Data 之轉載與發布機構頁面均已存檔，並附 PDF／PNG 鏡像。panel 中其他數值皆未變動。

scope: New variable gini_index: Gini index (0-100), all 40 countries, survey years within 2001-2022
scope_zh: 新增變項 gini_index：吉尼指數（0–100），全部 40 國，2001–2022 年間之調查年度
after: 679 values (40 countries; years with a survey only), range 23.2 to 65.0; ten columns gini_index[_source, _url, _ref_date, _note, _grade, _verification, _source_type, _flag, _collected_on] appended to the panel; 89 consumption-based values, 39 survey breaks and New Zealand's 17 OECD values flagged.
after_zh: 679 筆數值（40 國；僅有調查之年度），介於 23.2 至 65.0；panel 末尾新增 gini_index[_source、_url、_ref_date、_note、_grade、_verification、_source_type、_flag、_collected_on] 共十欄；89 筆消費基礎數值、39 個調查斷點與紐西蘭 17 筆 OECD 數值已標示旗標。
change: Added at the authors' request for every country of the panel. 38 countries from World Bank WDI SI.POV.GINI (Poverty and Inequality Platform, version 20260922_2021_01_02_PROD): all 652 values equal the platform's own survey estimates (x 100, one decimal). Taiwan (10 values) from the same platform, which WDI does not publish; New Zealand (17 values) from the OECD Income Distribution Database, as the World Bank has no data for it. Raw responses, metadata and the publishers' pages are archived with PDF/PNG mirrors. No other value in the panel changed.
change_zh: 應作者要求為 panel 之每一國家新增。38 國取自世界銀行 WDI SI.POV.GINI（貧窮與不平等平台，版本 20260922_2021_01_02_PROD）：652 筆數值均等於該平台自身之調查估計值（乘以 100，小數一位）。臺灣（10 筆）取自同一平台（WDI 未公布）；紐西蘭（17 筆）取自 OECD 所得分配資料庫（世界銀行無其資料）。API 原始回應、後設資料與發布機構頁面均已存檔，並附 PDF／PNG 鏡像。panel 中其他數值皆未變動。
